package student

import (
	"context"
	"errors"
	"testing"
	"time"

	"github.com/example/ms-student-service/internal/domain"
)

type onboardingTurnRepositoryStub struct {
	applyCommand domain.StudentOnboardingTurnCommand
	applyEnabled bool
	proof        domain.StudentOnboardingTurnNoEffectProof
	result       domain.StudentOnboardingTurnResult
	err          error
}

func (stub *onboardingTurnRepositoryStub) ApplyOnboardingTurn(_ context.Context, command domain.StudentOnboardingTurnCommand, enabled bool) (domain.StudentOnboardingTurnResult, bool, error) {
	stub.applyCommand, stub.applyEnabled = command, enabled
	return stub.result, false, stub.err
}
func (stub *onboardingTurnRepositoryStub) GetOnboardingTurn(context.Context, string, string) (domain.StudentOnboardingTurnResult, error) {
	return domain.StudentOnboardingTurnResult{}, domain.ErrNotFound
}
func (stub *onboardingTurnRepositoryStub) ProveOnboardingTurnNoEffect(_ context.Context, proof domain.StudentOnboardingTurnNoEffectProof) (domain.StudentOnboardingTurnResult, bool, error) {
	stub.proof = proof
	return stub.result, false, stub.err
}

func TestApplyStudentOnboardingTurnUsesCanonicalHashAndFeatureGate(t *testing.T) {
	stub := &onboardingTurnRepositoryStub{result: domain.StudentOnboardingTurnResult{Schema: domain.StudentOnboardingTurnResultSchema}}
	useCase := ApplyStudentOnboardingTurn{Turns: stub, Clock: onboardingClockStub{now: time.Date(2026, 9, 9, 0, 0, 0, 0, time.UTC)}, EffectsEnabled: false}
	result, err := useCase.Handle(context.Background(), validTurnCommandForUsecase())
	if err != nil || stub.applyEnabled || len(stub.applyCommand.RequestHash) != 64 || result.Schema != domain.StudentOnboardingTurnResultSchema {
		t.Fatalf("unexpected apply: result=%+v enabled=%t command=%+v err=%v", result, stub.applyEnabled, stub.applyCommand, err)
	}
	if stub.applyCommand.StudentID != "11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111" || stub.applyCommand.Slots[0].SlotCode != domain.StudentOnboardingSlotDirectionCode {
		t.Fatalf("command was not normalized before hashing: %+v", stub.applyCommand)
	}
}

func TestProveStudentOnboardingTurnNoEffectRequiresFullCommandAndServerHash(t *testing.T) {
	stub := &onboardingTurnRepositoryStub{}
	useCase := ProveStudentOnboardingTurnNoEffect{Turns: stub, Clock: onboardingClockStub{now: time.Date(2026, 9, 9, 0, 0, 0, 0, time.UTC)}}
	command := validTurnCommandForUsecase()
	_, err := useCase.Handle(context.Background(), domain.StudentOnboardingTurnNoEffectProof{Schema: domain.StudentOnboardingTurnNoEffectProofSchema, Command: command})
	if err != nil || len(stub.proof.Command.RequestHash) != 64 {
		t.Fatalf("proof did not derive its server-side hash: proof=%+v err=%v", stub.proof, err)
	}
	stub.err = domain.ErrConflict
	command.CanonicalStudentMessageID = "bad"
	if _, err := useCase.Handle(context.Background(), domain.StudentOnboardingTurnNoEffectProof{Schema: domain.StudentOnboardingTurnNoEffectProofSchema, Command: command}); !errors.Is(err, domain.ErrValidation) {
		t.Fatalf("malformed full command must fail before persistence: %v", err)
	}
}

func validTurnCommandForUsecase() domain.StudentOnboardingTurnCommand {
	confidence := 5000
	direction := " Backend "
	return domain.StudentOnboardingTurnCommand{
		Schema: domain.StudentOnboardingTurnSchema, StudentID: "11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111", StudentCommandID: "22222222-2222-4222-8222-222222222222",
		DialogID: "33333333-3333-4333-8333-333333333333", PersonalTeacherID: "44444444-4444-4444-8444-444444444444", TeacherTurnSequence: 1,
		CanonicalStudentMessageID: "55555555-5555-4555-8555-555555555555", SourceEventID: "66666666-6666-4666-8666-666666666666", DialogCausationID: "55555555-5555-4555-8555-555555555555",
		TeacherJobID: "77777777-7777-4777-8777-777777777777", AIExecutionID: onboardingTurnStringPointer("88888888-8888-4888-8888-888888888888"), CorrelationID: "55555555-5555-4555-8555-555555555555", CausationID: "88888888-8888-4888-8888-888888888888",
		ExpectedDraftVersion: 0, Slots: []domain.StudentOnboardingTurnSlot{{SlotCode: domain.StudentOnboardingSlotDirectionCode, CodeValue: &direction, Origin: domain.StudentOnboardingTurnOriginExplicitText, ConfidenceBasisPoints: &confidence}},
	}
}

func onboardingTurnStringPointer(value string) *string { return &value }
